services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: Nearly all exhibitions are initiated by curatorial staff, but occasionally outside exhibition proposals are accepted and implemented. To submit an exhibition proposal, please e-mail us at kaitlyn.morrison@ci.monroe.la.us. Please note that most exhibitions are scheduled at least two years in advance and require several levels of approval from within the museum and board. Bernard Mattox is a New Orleans-based artist who specializes in multi-media and ceramics. His work blends the vibrant imagery reminiscent of New Orleans street-life with totem-like figures that call to mind tribal imagery.
